notes.title: The Tavern Tales: Medieval Simulator — Early Access Release on Steam
notes.notes: [p]On [b]September 1, 2025[/b], we are proud to announce the official Early Access release of [i]The Tavern Tales: Medieval Simulator[/i] on [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3363530/The_Tavern_Tales_Medieval_Simulator/" style="button"]Steam[/url]. Over the past months, our team at Flash Ray Games has worked tirelessly to create an immersive and authentic medieval tavern experience — and now it’s finally time to open the doors![/p][p]In [i]The Tavern Tales[/i], you will:[/p][list][*][p][b]Run your own tavern[/b] — cook meals, serve drinks, and take care of every guest who steps through your door.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Upgrade and decorate[/b] — furnish your place, add atmosphere, and make your tavern the most popular in town.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Grow your garden[/b] — cultivate crops to use in recipes or sell for extra income.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Send out expeditions[/b] — gather exotic resources, unlock new recipes, and bring back unique souvenirs from dangerous journeys.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Interact with special guests[/b] — handle them wisely, as their influence may bring fortune… or trouble.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stay tuned to the town’s news[/b] — city events and notices can change the course of your tavern’s story.[/p][/*][/list][p]Early Access is not just about releasing the game early — it’s about [b]building it together with you[/b]. We want [i]The Tavern Tales[/i] to grow based on community feedback, player suggestions, and shared passion for cozy medieval life simulations.[/p][p]Mark your calendars: [b]September 1, 2025[/b]. Add the game to your wishlist, join us on this journey, and help us shape the future of [i]The Tavern Tales[/i].[/p][p]Prepare your pan, sharpen your axe, and invite your friends — the tavern opens soon, and your story begins![/p]
